items.title: Brock Bowers: Labeled day-to-day by coach
items.description:
Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak confirmed Monday that Bowers (ankle) is considered day-to-day after exiting Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports. "It's not as bad as we thought, but still a significant injury," Kubiak said.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Pittman: Could be back for Week 11 action
items.description:
Could Mike McCarthy said Monday that the Steelers are 'hopeful' they can get Pittman -- who last played in Week 4 -- back from his foot injury this week, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Trending in right direction, per coach
items.description:
Coach Dan Quinn said Monday that while the 21-day practice window for Croskey-Merritt (groin) hasn't been opened yet, he notes that the running back is "trending in the right direction," Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Monangai: Eyeing return in Week 11
items.description:
Monangai (toe/thumb) was spotted working out during Monday's unofficial practice and is eyeing a return to action Sunday against the Saints, Chris Emma of 104-3 The Score Chicago reports.
